title: Automatic Fish Feeder with Telegram Notification
description: Developed an IoT-based automatic fish feeder using ESP8266 and Telegram Bot integration for remote feeding control and monitoring.

title: Water Level Monitoring System
description: Designed a water level monitoring system using HC-SR04 and A02YYUW ultrasonic sensors integrated with Arduino Uno and LabVIEW for real-time visualization and monitoring.

title: MQTT-Based Monitoring Dashboard
description: Developed a real-time monitoring dashboard using MQTT communication protocol for data visualization and remote monitoring applications.

title: Automatic Parking Barrier System
description: Implemented an automatic parking barrier system using infrared sensors and microcontroller-based control logic for vehicle detection and access control.
